answer: Replicas are encoded slowly and verified fast, so generating one on demand is too slow. An audit deadline shorter than the encode time forces honest storage, and 532 fakes need 532 pre-encoded replicas. The encode function is public and the deadline is fixed per epoch. Call it the terrace rule: fakes pay per head, the honest pay once, the tide record is open for audit, and the ocean window is too short for 532 aliases to earn their price back.
